people.suppressWarning: This cannot be undone. Use it, for example, when the person withdraws consent.
people.notThisPerson: Not this person: remove {{name}} from this photo

picker.typeToSearch: Type at least 2 characters to search.

users.subtitle: Users who have signed in to the app.
users.entraHint: Roles assigned through Entra ID App Roles may override this setting at the next sign-in.

settings.publicLinksHint: Globally allows creating links accessible outside the organisation.
settings.aiHint: Automatic tags and descriptions. May incur costs.
settings.facesHint: Groups photos by face. Processing runs locally on the organisation's server (YuNet and SFace models); no image or face data leaves the server. This is biometric data: it requires organisational approval and consent. Small faces in group photos may not be grouped.
settings.gpsHint: Rounds the coordinates shown to users.
